adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new fallback path fetches a credential directly from the DB via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` when it isn’t found in `this.calendarCredentials`, and then uses it to call `createEvent(...)`. The diff shows no verification that the fetched credential belongs to the booking’s organizer/user/team, so a `destinationCalendar` entry containing another user’s `credentialId` could be used to create/write calendar events under that credential (IDOR-style authorization bug) introduced by adding this DB fallback.
